assets.prompt: Create a 3 by 2 sprite sheet on one perfectly flat solid chroma-key green #00FF00 background with exactly six isolated mobile game button icons, one icon in each cell, row-major order, very wide green gutters, no labels, letters, numbers, or UI mockup. Do not use #00FF00 inside any icon. Cell 1: a lively coral play button symbol built from a small cluster of four colorful cat tiles with one clear forward triangle accent, for starting classic mode. Cell 2: a circular coral replay arrow wrapping around one warm-ivory cat tile, for starting another round. Cell 3: a curved teal undo arrow with a small paw accent, for undoing one move. Cell 4: a chunky raspberry eraser sweeping away one small low-level cat tile, for removing the lowest tile. Cell 5: an open warm-ivory scrapbook with a simple purple cat silhouette and collectible page tabs, for the cat collection. Cell 6: a bold green check mark with a small paw accent, for confirming an action. Every icon should be a single readable silhouette with a consistent dark charcoal outline, warm ivory enamel badge shape, coral, teal, mustard, green, raspberry and violet accents, subtle painted texture, restrained highlights, no text, no gradients, no shadows outside the icon, and remain clear at 64 px.
